guard: Fixed bootstrap signing releases only after both native fences, binds actual expiry and never repeats a reserved signing attempt
why: The unexported issuer runs through real private JWT-broker admission, activation, ledger and gate CAS paths. Two timing seams move native fences; no full admission endpoint, file delivery, redemption or hosted execution is claimed.

mutations.name: bootstrap omits registration fence finalization
mutations.expectRed: a racing registration fence revokes the staged row and releases nothing
mutations.cell: a racing registration fence revokes the staged row and releases nothing

mutations.name: bootstrap omits native lifecycle finalization
mutations.expectRed: a racing lifecycle fence revokes the staged row and releases nothing
mutations.cell: a racing lifecycle fence revokes the staged row and releases nothing

mutations.name: bootstrap ledger lifetime exceeds the actual JWT
mutations.expectRed: bootstrap ledger binds the reserved principal root lineage and actual JWT expiry
mutations.cell: bootstrap ledger binds the reserved principal root lineage and actual JWT expiry

mutations.name: bootstrap resurrects a deleted signing reservation
mutations.expectRed: a deleted signing reservation cannot be resurrected
mutations.cell: a deleted signing reservation cannot be resurrected

mutations.name: bootstrap loses create-only signing custody
mutations.expectRed: same-input signing replay stays held without advancing its reservation
mutations.cell: same-input signing replay stays held without advancing its reservation

mutations.name: bootstrap accepts a changed native admission binding
mutations.find:
if (contractDigest(staged) !== contractDigest(expected))
    throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", "environment bootstrap does not match the staged admission");
mutations.expectRed: changed admission revision refuses before signing
mutations.cell: changed admission revision refuses before signing
